title: A · Plan column on Places
why: Places stays the list you build from; each row shows + or its stop number. PLAN is a second list for following.
frames: 1 Switch · Panel: PLACES | PLAN control, then which plan + adds to.
2 Build · Every place, every filter; tap + to append, tap the number to take it out.
3 Follow · PLAN: only the stops, in order, NEXT in the meta; map shows only the stops.
4 Reorder · Drag the grip (right slot). No edit mode.

title: B · The plan is the sheet (pick)
why: Open a plan and the sheet is the plan: its stops on top, then everything else in your list with +. One view builds and follows.
frames: 1 Switch · Panel: PLACES | PLANS control; the Plans side lists plans and New plan.
2 Build · Stops, a rule, then every place from the list with +; map shows everything, stops numbered.
3 Follow · The same sheet: stops first, NEXT in the meta, the rest below the rule.
4 Reorder · Drag the grip; drop below the rule to take a stop out (Undo).

title: C · Plans as saved lists
why: Like Google Maps Save: add a place from its popup to any plan. PLANS shows your plans as a list; open one to follow it.
frames: 1 Switch · PLANS turns the list into your plans; tap one to open it.
2 Build · Tap a row, the popup gains ADD TO PLAN; a slip picks the plan (tick = in it).
3 Follow · Open plan: its stops in order, ‹ All plans on top; map shows only the stops.
